classes: Vehicle classes (4): rail, road, ship, air; each has its own engine-row block in src/table/engines.h (MT, MM, MW for rail; MR road; MS ship; MA air)
Factions: companies, each with a colour (src/company_func.h:39); AI-run companies in src/ai (not read)
Progression: vehicle rows gated by introduction date (base in days since 1920, src/table/engines.h:18), life length and decay (macro fields, engines.h:26)
Cargo rows (35): label, colour, weight and cargo-class list (src/table/cargo_const.h:58)
gear_tiers: Introduction generations, not materials: 256 engine and wagon rows (rail 116, road 88, ship 11, air 41) gated by date and climate bitmask (src/table/engines.h)
Reliability drains on every breakdown check and resets at the depot (src/vehicle.cpp:189-203, 1333)
No metallic, gold or glow tiers; liveries use company colours (src/company_func.h:39)
zones: Four climates: temperate, arctic (snow line), tropic, toyland (src/table/engines.h:91-97; snow line pointer at src/landscape.cpp:108)
No dungeon archetypes; open maps with towns and industries (layouts not read)

Disaster hazard actors (not creatures): zeppelin (crashes at an airport, src/disaster_vehicle.cpp:228), small UFO (hunts a road vehicle), airplane (attacks an oil refinery), helicopter (attacks a factory), big UFO and big UFO destroyer, small and big submarine, coal-mine event (table at src/disaster_vehicle.cpp:940-950)
Scheduler: daily timer, delay of 730 days plus up to 511 more, uniform pick among the events whose year window is open (src/disaster_vehicle.cpp:964, 970, 974, 980)

Flood: tile-by-tile spread; a train or road vehicle below the flood level crashes; a flooded road vehicle gets a crash timer of 2000 against 1 normally (src/water_cmd.cpp:1098-1122, 1209; src/roadveh_cmd.cpp:558)

looks.label: Blinking threat
looks.technique: The small UFO flips to a darker sprite on tick bit 3, so a hover reads as alive.

looks.label: Ground shadow for flyers
looks.technique: Each flying hazard has a shadow subtype drawn on the ground under it, so height reads at any zoom.

looks.label: Breakdown smoke with an engine off-flag
looks.technique: An engine flag decides whether the breakdown smoke plays.

looks.label: Animated tile list
looks.technique: A list of animated tiles advanced each tick; tiles that stop animating are removed from the list.

looks.label: Owner colour
looks.technique: A colour table per owner used on vehicles and station signs.

looks.label: Flood as a tile change
looks.technique: Plain rail tiles are flooded in place with a halftile water state.

originals.name: Timed Visitor
originals.idea: A threat timer with jitter, a window of allowed threats, and a uniform pick.
originals.change: Windows keyed to zone tier and time spent in the zone, not calendar years.

originals.name: Hunter Scout
originals.idea: A roaming enemy wanders six waypoints, then locks on to a live target, skipping targets already taken.
originals.keep: The lock rule and leave-if-no-target rule (src/disaster_vehicle.cpp:342-363).
originals.change: Targets are player carts or mounts; a ground shadow shows the approach (src/disaster_vehicle.h:21).

originals.name: Pity Meter
originals.idea: Each check adds one to a hidden chance; a rare roll adds 25 more; the counter resets when the event fires.
originals.keep: The streak breaker and the table lookup by reliability bits (src/vehicle.cpp:1352-1366).
originals.change: A visible pressure meter instead of a hidden number. No defect found in the lines read; the clamp at vehicle.cpp:1363 covers the ship and reduced-setting bonuses.

originals.name: Rising Tide
originals.idea: A flood that spreads tile by tile and disables anything it catches for a long time.
originals.keep: The spread and the long disable (src/water_cmd.cpp:1209; src/roadveh_cmd.cpp:558).
originals.change: A timed tide with a warning ring that the reader sees before it arrives.

originals.name: Shrine Grace
originals.idea: Service at a safe point resets wear and quarters the breakdown chance.
originals.change: The shrine shows a shield aura for the grace time; no reduced-mode switch.

originals.name: Climate Roster
originals.idea: Each gear row lists the zones it can appear in, as a bitmask.
originals.keep: The bitmask per row (src/table/engines.h:91-97 and the macro field).
originals.change: The bitmask gates loot tables and spawn lists, not vehicles.

originals.name: Idle List
originals.idea: A list of animated props; each tick advances the ones still active and removes the rest.
originals.change: Only props near the player are on the list.
